name: University of Melbourne Housing Bursary
summary: Up to $4,000 for University of Melbourne students paying rent or board who are in financial need.
who: Enrolled in a course at the University of Melbourne.
Paying rent or board (not a mortgage).
how: You're considered automatically when you apply for the Student Bursaries.
catches: Paid in two instalments in April and September.

evidence.quote: If you have submitted an application for the Student Bursaries you will be automatically considered for this bursary.
